title: A few months with Benny Goodman
summary: In 1945 he played one-nighters and a week at Steel Pier with Goodman, with Slam Stewart and Red Norvo.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Yeah, I worked a few months with Benny, and the time I was with him, Slam Stewart was with him, and Red Norvo was with him same time I was with him. Who else was with him? He had a big band.
What did you do - tour one-nighters or what?

Yeah, we did one-nighters, couple theaters, mostly one nighters. I didn't work long with him, though. I played down at Atlantic City with him for about a week at that Steel Pier down there. Yeah, I played down there. And Jane Arby was singing with him then, and I saw her not long ago. She's married to a producer or something like that out in Hollywood here, uh-huh.
